More than 1 year of steady nutrient release

variants.name: Tropica Aquarium Soil Powder (3 L / 9 L)

specs.value: About 1–1.5 mm, finer than the normal grade, for foreground plants

fits.fact: The shop says it suits both shrimp tanks and planted tanks, and the hard grains make planting easy
Sold as suitable for fish, shrimp and plants in newly set-up tanks
For easy plants like Anubias and Bucephalandra, it is enough on its own and needs almost no extra fertiliser
The shop says it helps red plants show stronger colour
For heavily planted Dutch or Nature-style tanks, the shop suggests adding Tropica Substrate or a Vietnamese mixed base layer underneath
The powder grade's finer grain suits foreground planting and small tanks
A comparison review sees it as best for hobbyists who want easier cycling at a lower price than ADA. pH settled around 6.5 in its tests

usage.fact: Work out how much you need: length × width × depth in cm, divided by 1000, gives litres
For the first 4 weeks, change 30–50% of the water twice a week
Another shop says to change 25–50% of the water at least twice a week for the first 4 weeks
Frequent water changes in the first month help prevent algae
The shop says the water clears quickly after the tank is filled
Nutrients can run low after about 10–12 months, so root tabs should be added from then on

issues.fact: Releases some ammonia after setup. One forum user measured about 0.5 mg/l and cleared it over a few weeks with big water changes and a mature filter
The ammonia release is milder and the cycle shorter than ADA Amazonia, but the nutrients run out sooner
Buyers report bags turning partly to dust in shipping and some grains crumbling when the tank is filled, which clouds the water
Stock in Vietnam is patchy. Some shops list the 9 L bag as sold out
The Marine Aqua product page mentions another brand (Chihiros) in its description, so check with the shop that you are getting genuine Tropica

alternatives.why: Better choice for long-running planted or shrimp-breeding tanks: harder grains and pH buffering that lasts longer. The trade-offs are a strong ammonia spike, the need for a fishless cycle, and a higher price
Cheaper option that buffers pH well, but the grains are softer and compact sooner. Suits tanks you plan to rescape within 12–18 months
